report:
1. Building Constantine's tramway cost 44 billion dinars, almost three times the initial estimate. [Wikipédia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tramway_de_Constantine)
2. El Capitan replaced Frontier as the world's fastest supercomputer in November 2024. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
3. Frontier uses roughly 9,500 AMD Epyc CPUs and 37,900 Instinct MI250X GPUs. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
4. Algeria's youth unemployment rate stood just under 30% in 2025. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
5. Algeria's provinces had a combined population of 29,276,767 at the 2008 census. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
6. Fugaku was the world's first exascale supercomputer. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
7. Around 90% of Egypt's water comes from the Nile. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
8. The GERD's main dam is 145 m tall, and a passenger ferry service now operates across its reservoir. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
9. The GERD was formally inaugurated on 9 September 2024. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
10. Senegal won the 2019 Africa Cup of Nations final 1–0 against Algeria. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final)
11. Lapeyssonnie observed that the disease occurred in areas receiving 30–110 cm of mean annual rainfall. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
12. Burkina Faso, Ethiopia and Niger together account for more than 60% of all meningitis cases in Africa. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
13. Constantine Province had 815,032 inhabitants at the 2008 census. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
14. Baghdad Bounedjah scored the only goal of the 2019 Africa Cup of Nations final, in the second minute. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final)
15. In 2007, Algeria exported US$73.3 billion of goods, more than twice the value of its imports. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
16. President Abdelaziz Bouteflika inaugurated the Beni Haroun dam on 5 January 2004. [Wikipédia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barrage_de_Beni_Haroun)
17. Frontier first topped the TOP500 list in its June 2021 edition. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
18. Large meningitis epidemics in the belt occur every 5–10 years, typically during the dry season. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
19. Algeria effectively nationalised its hydrocarbon industry in 1971 by taking 51% of the local assets of French oil companies. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
20. Algeria joined OPEC in 1969 and was a founding member of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum in 2001. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
